headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 29, 2026**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Grayson Rodriguez earning the win. Wenceel Pérez led the Angels' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. In other games, the Atlanta Braves dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 10-2 victory, while the Toronto Blue Jays secured a narrow win over the Baltimore Orioles.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with Brant Hurter being transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to lumbar spine inflammation by the Detroit Tigers. Casey Mize has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 28, 2026, with right adductor inflammation. Tyler Mahle has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 27, 2026, with a left hamstring strain.

The Detroit Tigers have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, trading RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for LHP Juanmi Vasquez. The Cincinnati Reds have traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley.

top_news.title: **Angels Soar Past Tigers 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Grayson Rodriguez earning the win. Wenceel Pérez led the Angels' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall to White Sox in 6-2 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins suffered a 6-2 defeat at the hands of the Chicago White Sox, with Randal Grichuk leading the Twins' offense with 3 RBIs. Davis Martin earned the win for the White Sox, pitching 6.0 innings with 5 strikeouts and 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Braves Blast Red Sox 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 10-2 victory. Ronald Acuña Jr. led the Braves' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Edge Orioles in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a narrow win over the Baltimore Orioles, with Jeff Hoffman earning the win and Louis Varland securing the save.

top_news.title: **Tigers Transfer Brant Hurter to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers have updated the status of LHP Brant Hurter, transferring him from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to lumbar spine inflammation.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire LHP Juanmi Vasquez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, trading RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for LHP Juanmi Vasquez.
